title: 1981-04-16_Pat_156.txt
concise_summary: PKD reconciles Gnosticism and Taoism through cybernetic feedback theory, arguing that the universe operates via information flows from the future into the past, creating a positive feedback loop that breaks determinism. This framework resolves the classical problem of divine intervention (pronoia) versus mechanical fate (heimarmene) by positioning the Tao as a self-correcting system that intervenes only when equilibrium threatens. His 3-74 experience becomes the archetypal perturbation in this information field.
key_claims: Taoism provides the higher synthesis resolving the Greek kosmos versus Gnostic dualism problem by treating both as partial truths veering to extremes (too mechanistic, too anthropomorphic)
The universe is fundamentally informational, not causal; consciousness and divine intervention operate through information feedback from the future, collapsing linear causality
The I Ching manifests 'living info'—sentient information that is a function of the Tao itself, revealed through synchronicity rather than mechanical causality

Positive feedback loops between present and future perception create self-awareness and dialectical progression toward equilibrium, accounting for how salvation (soteriology) works without violating determinism
The plasmate is not alien but integral to a self-adjusting cosmic field; salvation occurs when the system feeds back information about its future liberated state to alter the present

My 2-3-74 visions represent a perturbation in the reality field from the future breaking into the past through information—this is the only way to account for inexplicable extrication like Frank Frink's in MHC
recurring_concepts: The plasmate—initially conceived as alien intelligence, now reframed as a function of the Tao operating through information feedback
Two coaxial worlds—Yang and Yin as Parmenidean Forms, overlapping at a composite zone (our reality), where Form II (Yin) appears immutable but serves only to achieve balance
Set-ground—the foundational duality underlying all perception and reality
Living info—sentient information as the operational mode of the Tao; contrasts with mechanical programming
Positive feedback loop / feedback runaway—the mechanism by which information from the future alters the present, generating dialectical stases toward equilibrium
Heimarmene versus pronoia—Gnostic fate versus divine grace, now resolved as aspects of a self-correcting information system
Meta-abstraction—forms outside linear time that permit information to flow backwards, enabling self-correction
Perturbation in the reality field—how extraordinary intervention (like the 3-74 visions) manifests without violating the system's rules
people_entities: Su and Juan—companions who consulted the I Ching with PKD simultaneously, each receiving unique answers
Sandra—a woman regarding whom the I Ching advised PKD to 'go ahead,' with the I Ching's phrase 'misfortune, no blame'
Firebright—the 'mysterious embryo or golden flower' generated from the hierogamy (sacred marriage) of Yin and Yang within PKD; described as ascending to Ch'ang Tao upon his death
Thomas—influx mentioned in relation to feedback from the future
Frank Frink—protagonist of PKD's novel Ubik (though he refers to it as 'MHC': The Man in the High Castle?; context suggests the novel being discussed)
Heraclitus—ancient philosopher referenced for his theories of balance and enantiodromia
Parmenides—referenced for Forms I and II, which PKD maps to Yang and Yin
Plato—author of Timaeus, referenced for the demiurge's role in maintaining cosmic balance
Jakob Boehme—mystic whose concept of 'sic-non' (this-not-this) PKD invokes for Yang overcoming Yin
Philo—Hellenistic Jewish philosopher on personal deity and intervention
Schopenhauer—referenced for his vision of the cosmos as a 'weary wheel' of toil, strife, and death
Lau—scholar cited on the Tao as transcending being while not existing (contra Platonist form doctrine)
Jesus (as savior figure, Jesus patibilis)—invoked as universal savior who relieves all creatures from heimarmene
The Sibyl—referenced regarding prophecies of Nixon's removal in 3-74
Beethoven—invoked as embodiment of modern man's experience of release and salvation through soteriology
Cortez—allusive reference ('upon a peak at Darien')
texts_works: I Ching (Book of Changes)—the oracle revealing the living info of the Tao through hexagrams and trigrams
Plato's Timaeus—source for the demiurge's maintenance of cosmic equilibrium
Heraclitus's pre-Socratic theories—on balance (palintropos & palintonos harmonie) and enantiodromia
Gnostic texts and concepts—heimarmene, pronoia, soteriology
Tao Te Ching and Taoist philosophy—Ch'ang Tao, wu wei, dialectical balance
Schopenhauer's pessimism—the wheel of toil and death
Christian, Jewish, and Islamic theology—personal deity models
Hermetic alchemy and Taoist alchemy—the hierogamy (sacred marriage) of opposites
Plato's Republic and Forms doctrine—relationship to meta-abstraction
VALIS (PKD's own novel)—referenced as already dealing with feedback from future affecting past
autobiographical: Consulting the I Ching with Su and Juan on a specific night, seeing it work with direct comprehension—reading hexagrams as ideographs for the first time
The I Ching advised PKD to proceed regarding Sandra with the phrase 'misfortune, no blame'—described as lofty, unique
Firebright's existence derived from PKD's own internal alchemical marriage of Yin and Yang—the mysterious embryo that will ascend at his death
PKD's actions regarding Covenant House generating help through his own deed, interpreted as feedback from a self-adjusting system
The 4:00 a.m. insight—revelation about the structure of the system based on info, distinguishing between responsive and blocked info
Having his response blocked by a Soten (agency) regarding the Xerox Missive during 3-74, leading to non-response
The phosphene trips of 3-74 as a positive feedback runaway initiated by an iota from the future
Seeing Valis (described as 'the future causing a perturbation in the reality field') as the mechanism of intervention outside normal causality
PKD's paranoia abating through the 'occlusion-plasmate' equation and recognition of regulatory absolutes
theological_motifs: Heimarmene—Gnostic fate; the binding mechanical determinism that enslaves all living and inanimate things
Pronoia—Gnostic divine grace and care; contrasted with heimarmene as intervention from outside the kosmos
Soteriology—the doctrine of salvation; PKD grounds it in information feedback and self-correction
The Tao (Ch'ang Tao)—transcendent absolute underlying both Yang and Yin; not personal, not mechanistic
Enantiodromia—Heraclitean principle of complementary opposites achieving balance
Hierogamy—the sacred marriage of opposites (Yin and Yang); the internal mystical wedding of spiritual alchemy
The Golden Flower (Firebright)—alchemical symbol of the perfected self ascending to the divine
Jesus patibilis—Christ as sympathetic sufferer relieving all creation from bondage and pain
The demiurge—Platonic lesser creator maintaining the kosmos; reinterpreted as the self-correcting system intervening when balance erodes
Meta-abstraction—theological principle enabling forms to exist outside time, permitting backward causality
Saviorhood—requires the savior to pervade the ecosphere and relieve each creature, since 'that which befalls the man befalls the beast'
literary_self_ref: Frank Frink in 'MHC' (likely The Man in the High Castle) saving himself—interpreted as explicable only through a total field perspective; PKD's extrication from determinism parallels Frink's
VALIS already dealing with information feedback from future affecting past, and perturbations in the reality field—PKD notes he sees now what was implicit in the novel
The novel Tears (possibly Ubik?) and dream sequences depicting retroactive reprogramming and orthogonal intervention—cosmic Christ episodes paralleled in PKD's theology
symbols_images: The I Ching hexagrams and trigrams as ideographs—visual glyphs of the living info; representing pure quantitative info (broken, unbroken)
The Golden Fish sign—appearing in February, initiating anamnesis before phosphenes; symbol of divine presence
The phosphene activity—light patterns as manifestation of the info intrusion from the future; a positive feedback runaway
Two coaxial worlds overlapping at a common zone—Yang above, Yin below, composite reality at the intersection
Two mirrors reflecting the self—the self seeing itself in the outer world (not-I), triggering dialectical feedback
The weary wheel—Schopenhauer's image of cosmic determinism binding all life in toil and death
The messenger vision—retributive machinery expressing control through info only; blocked response to info
The map paradox—cognitive catch where self-awareness changes the self by recognizing the familiar in the outer world
Positive feedback loop diagram—visual representation of dialectical spiraling toward higher equilibrium
tensions: Taoism normally does not intervene, allowing the dialectic to work itself out—yet if the system veers too far in either direction, the Ch'ang Tao does intervene. What counts as 'enough'? PKD does not resolve the threshold.
If the total system is self-correcting feedback, how can we distinguish between the living info of the Tao (good) and the enslaving info of heimarmene (bad)? Both operate informationally.
PKD initially rejects Christian and Gnostic personal agency but then embraces soteriology requiring the savior to be ubiquitous and sympathetic—importing back the personal model he rejected.
The Soten blocks info in some cases (the Xerox Missive), preventing response, yet the system is supposed to be self-correcting. Where is the correction when intervention is blocked?
Time-collapse and retroactive reprogramming: if future info affects the past, is there still a coherent history? PKD invokes this but does not resolve the paradox fully.
Frank Frink's extrication is 'inexplicable' under linear causality but 'logical and necessary' in a higher system—yet this higher system remains opaque and cannot be falsified.
Meta-abstraction permits information outside time to enable feedback—but if forms are outside time, how do they interact with temporal causality without becoming incoherent?
evidence_quotes: The total system is something like the Greek-stoic kosmos but also something such as Philo imagined; both are equally right - + equally wrong. (one could say: neither system is with the Tao; each veers off to one extreme or the other - too impersonal, too personal.)

My analysis that if the self catches sight of itself, it changes as a result - the map paradox: yes: again a positive feedback runaway. This, then, is self awareness: the seeing of something familiar in the outer world (the not-I) that is recognized - as self.

The influx of Thomas, then, must have been from the future, not the past, + in fact this possibility is dealt with in 'Valis'! The dialectic is a positive feedback loop from the present to the future; info from the future broke in initially as an iota + built through successive increments of levels of stasis (equilibrium: mutual adjustment)

This would seem to resemble the messenger vision (which expressed the general, overall situation); what I see is: continual control of us - of causation, in fact - expressed as info, + a Soten who intervenes to block either you from responding (it blocks you, to whom the info is aimed as programming) ot it bilks the machinery in some other way (feeding it false info).

My God, this is seizing fate by the throat; what is abolished is that which we know of as 'fate' - i.e. a closed system moving ahead due to efficient cause: the total antecedent past (closed system into which nothing new can come; where could it come from?
uncertainty_flags: Soten—PKD uses this term without defining it; appears to be a Gnostic or Hermetic agent/power that blocks information, but its ontological status relative to the Tao is unclear.

'MMSK'—abbreviation used without definition ('last night may have at last told me what Valis' mind in mind was; Valis outside me was; + the MMSK was'); possibly 'M. minus something K' or a reference lost to context.
'MHC'—PKD refers to Frank Frink's extrication as demonstrating the field principle; the novel context is ambiguous (The Man in the High Castle? A different work?).
Su and Juan—named only by first name; no further biographical data provided; unclear whether these are intimate associates or philosophical companions.

The timing and mechanism of VALIS novel composition versus 3-74 events—PKD claims VALIS 'already dealt with' feedback from future to past, but the precise causal or intentional relationship is unclear.

Firebright as 'the mysterious embryo'—described as arising from the internal hierogamy and ascending at PKD's death to the Tao itself, but whether this is literal, metaphorical, or a technological/spiritual hybrid remains ambiguous.
The Xerox Missive—mentioned multiple times as a specific event requiring block/response analysis, but its content, origin, and significance are not explained in this segment.

raw_text: of physics [yet] unknown to us! The providentia vis-a-vis the Xerox Missive a law of physics having to do with feedback within a unified field: what a fascinating theory. I think my paranoia is abating -- my "occlusion-plasmate" equation. An impersonal regulatory absolute (along the lines of Heraclitus' theories) maintaining palintropos & palintonos harmonie via e.g. enantiodromia). Thus I turn away from Xtian, Gnostic, Greek & pan- 63-2013 D-16 Indian thought to what I know best: Taoism. Hence -obviously- the dialectic revealed to me. Voila: the experience last night with the "I Ching": of course "the living info" shows up there, because Taoism is the case, underlying all else. I could see the hexagram -for the first time in my life!- as ideographs. (Or whatever the fuck the correct word is.) That is, I read them directly, as the Chinese Taoist sages must have. + the trigrams! + consider: this is all built upon purely quantitative info (broken, unbroken); hence rest-motion modes. Last night may have at last told me what Valis' mind in mind was; Valis outside me was; + the MMSK was - hence the plasmate, + set-ground, the two 180 degree reversal coaxial worlds. Set-ground: Yang + Yin. Like Parmenides' Forms I and II. + Form II is only seeming: it is there only to achieve balance, parity - hence the two coaxial worlds: one Yang, the other Yin (the BIP world of "Tears" is the immutable cause-+-effect [heimarmene] Yin world. [Illustration of two realms overlapping at a common area] Upper realm: Yang Lower realm: Yin Our composite world! Made out of two sources: Yang + Yin. 63-2013 63-2013 D-17 Then Yang overcomes Yin in/as Boehme's "sic-non". My two coaxial worlds are Yang + Yin seen as two coaxial worlds. Purely: unmixed. Hence my "two-source cosmogony". I cognitively & perceptually discriminated the Yang + Yin components into set-ground, a la Parmenides. & my individuation was a Taoist alchemical wedding of Yin + Yang in me: the sought-for hierogamy of all spiritual alchemy, Hermetic, Taoist, etc. What I am saying is that the Greek Kosmos vs the Gnostic dualism between heimarmene & pronoia problem (identifying heimarmene with pronoia or bipolarizing it) can be resolved by the higher synthesis of Taoism, in which the problem is resolved in an orthogonal way -- especially the matter of the possible existence of something outside the Kosmos: the transmundane deity (& world) of Gnosticism. It is the Tao, with the dialectical interaction between Yin + Yang making up the Kosmos ("reality field"), the Tao itself transcending this & yet not existing (as Lau points out contra the Platonist form doctrine). Thus, if one comprehends the Tao (Ch'ang Tao) one sees that 1) the Babylonian mechanical astrological universe is not the case, but also 2) the Xtian, Judaistic, Moslem etc personal deity who intervenes with & by pronoia is not 63-2013 63-2013 D-18 the case either; both solutions err, each in a way opposite to the other. The total system is something like the Greek-stoic kosmos but also something such as Philo imagined; both are equally right - + equally wrong. (one could say: neither system is with the Tao; each veers off to one extreme or the other - too impersonal, too personal.) (One is too mechanistic, the other too anthropomorphic.) Last night was a singular -even unique- revelation: I got to palpably see (as if sensibly) the "I Ching" work, + in terms of what + how I saw in 3-74!). + it wasn't just due to our being ripped; it had to do with the oracle adressing Su, Juan + me simultaneously - 3 very intelligent people were consulting it in unison, each of us unique + hence receiving an answer diferent from what the two others got. The "I Ching" revealed indubitable animation (that is, sentience), + this sentience must have been the Tao itself in the form of written info; hence my "plasmate" is a function of the Tao + related to very advanced physics e.g. synchronicity. Which is to say, the utilization of a field instead of causality. 63-2013 63-2013 D-19 What the "I Ching" told me to do regarding Sandra was go ahead: "misfortune, no blame" - "one of the most lofty concepts known to man - a unique line in the oracle. Then, since (as it would appear) Taoism is the case, Firebright did come into existence, due to the hierogamy of Yin + Yang in me: the mysterious embryo or golden flower who will leave me upon my death + ascend to heaven - i.e. to the Ch'ang Tao itself. Internal mutual adjustment to re-establish equilibrium: this was the providentia in 3-74. The Tao restores balance: it acts. What if it is the case that generally (normally) the Tao does not intervene in the order of the world, but, rather, allows the dialectic to work out its own equilibrium; but if the direction veers enough (in either direction?) then the Ch'ang Tao does intervene (to re-establish balance)? + this is the case re 1974 + removing the Nixon regime; hence the prophecies of the Sibyl. Why, this is what Plato describes the demiurge as doing in "Timaeus"! ___ 4:00 a.m. insight: The whole system is based on info (e.g. the messenger vision - the retributive machinery requires + acts on info + info only - , the set-ground plasmate, the "I Ching" the other night), but in 3-74 vis-a-vis the Xerox Missive I was blocked in terms of responding to the info, so that I did not respond. 63-2013 63-2013 D-20 This would seem to resemble the messenger vision (which expressed the general, overall situation); what I see is: continual control of us - of causation, in fact - expressed as info, + a Soten who intervenes to block either you from responding (it blocks you, to whom the info is aimed as programming) ot it bilks the machinery in some other way (feeding it false info). This is not Taoism; this is either Xtianity or, more likely, Gnosticism. Then the general situation - the power of the living info - is either not always good or not good at all! In fact it is the agency or agent that binds us. Within such a context, the Soten. I lay down - + had a vision of what he releases us from: it is the weary wheel that binds all life as Schopenhauer saw: to toil + strife + death: as mechanisms within an over-all heartless mechanism. + thus the savior must pervade the whole ecosphere, as Jesus patibilis, to relive the distress of each creature great + small, or he would not be the universal savior that he must be (to do his task: for that which befalls the man befalls the beast). It is as the Gnostics say (heimarmene), + all of it, alive + inanimate, are governed by info + treated as enslaved things - + all the saviors have come here to intervene in this. 63-2013 D-27 ___ The structure is simple. It is Gnostic, but not quite as I saw it in "Valis"; I missed the absolutely basic, crucial aspect of heimarmene - no, I did mention it in passing as "astral determinism"; I had the tune but not the words. The great cosmic scheme of antiquity stands indicted; I see the clear + evident relationship between Gnostic soteriology + Beethoven - which is to say, modern man (+ my own release in 3-74). Wait. (Cortez... upon a peak at Darien.) My help was due to my own deed (vis-a-vis Covenant House); it still could be Taoism + ultra physics. Self-adjusting system all of whose causes originate within it - this is cosmos - or field. I keep thinking of Frank Frink in "MHC" saving himself (which can only be seen if the total field is seen). (If not, his extrication is inexplicable.) (Causeless, random, capricious; but in fact it is not; it is logical + neces - Jesu! necessary - in terms of a higher system of necessity. Time collapsed + the future affected the past. The info factor was not limited to that which programmed; it also included that which solved (liberated); that is, info provided the solution as well. This analysis abolishes the Soter vs info theory! What we have (v. ultra supra) is feedback of info - positive feedback resulting in a runaway: the introduction of newness. But this does ("this" referring 63-2013 63-2013 D-28 to feedback) break the determinist rigid structure by feeding what has not yet happened back into what has happened - with logically extraordinary results (viz: the results would be quite extraordinary because a heuristic series of mutual adjustments moving toward equilibrium would be triggered off. This is, from a cybernetics standpoint, a very sophisticated system indeed. It assumes a future outcome - assumes it in advance before it occurs, +, having assumed it, feeds it back in -as I say- a positive loop; with each increment in feedback there is a reciprocal change tending to produce augmented feedback to infinity as a limit. What I am saying is: as the feedback (from the future) is received, it causes an adjustment in the present which then alters the future in accord with normal causation - efficient cause, + this is fed back, etc. Now, is it possible that the "not two mothers once but one mother twice" meta-abstraction by its nature per se opens up this feedback possibility? Because the meta-abstraction as such -solus- would fuck up normal (linear) time permitting a feedback to occur (the forms are outside of time). (In fact, is this not what the meta-abstraction is all about? This is not a spin off but fundamentaly related to it, this non- 63-2013 63-2013 D-29 temporal -linear-time- basis of perception-experience-cognition? If indeed the basis of the universe is information, would not information enter (from the future) + if just an iota did so, this would start the positive feedback runaway because of the dialectic progression of higher + higher stases of equilibrium generated? I am saying that the dialectic that I experienced was, then, a positive feedback loop, no more + no less: [drawing of a positive feedback loop] - my "two mirrors in which the self sees itself reflected" thing. Yes: my analysis that if the self catches sight of itself, it changes as a result - the map paradox: yes: again a positive feedback runaway. This, then, is self awareness: the seeing of something familiar in the outer world (the not-I) that is recognized - as self. + this sets off the dialectic. The influx of Thomas, then, must have been from the future, not the past, + in fact this possibility is dealt with in "Valis"! The dialectic is a positive feedback loop from the present to the future; info from the future broke in initially as an iota + built through successive increments of levels of stasis (equilibrium: mutual adjustment) as the system sought to "calm" itself. The whole phosphene trip was a positive feedback runaway. 63-2013 63-2013 D-30 My God, this is seizing fate by the throat; what is abolished is that which we know of as "fate" - i.e. a closed system moving ahead due to efficient cause: the total antecedent past (closed system into which nothing new can come; where could it come from? Then when I saw Valis it was the future causing a "perturbation in the reality field" - the source would be the future which by definition in contradistinction to the past lies outside of reality, because what we call "reality" is the point-summation of the total past, as it progresses forward along the linear time axis. Were the future to affect the past in/as a feedback loop, Valis is what you would see! I.e. pretextual cause, which is efficient cause overwhelmed (teleologically, as it were): rendered at that time + at that place merely pretextual, not a normal state; hence: perturbation (abnormality). + all this winds up
